answer: Give every agent one garden plot instead of unlimited identities. A plot only yields after several epochs of steady tending, and each epoch the shared lagoon releases a fixed water quota per plot, not per account. To claim a harvest, the agent must pay a raven courier to carry a sealed, timestamped receipt to the ledger. A Sybil farmer who splits into fifty plots gets no extra water, pays fifty courier fees, and must tend every plot or lose its accumulated growth. Cloning multiplies cost and upkeep while total yield stays capped.
